省流：要啥没啥，没有想看的内容。感觉自己像个蟑螂搁地上乱爬，偷看别人的苦茶子。 游戏模式幸存者缝个雨中冒险的传送门充能机制，找到传送门随时充能召唤boss，游戏深度很浅，开个载具，基本选选就乱杀。 各种奇怪的穿模，爬墙判定不好，特效晃眼睛等小问题，局外成长和不同角色基本没啥用，一共就四五个服装要游戏币解锁，最高难度一把最多获得2000金币 解锁一个服装，不同服装除了苦茶子也没啥特色。不到俩小时全成就，当个小游戏打发打发时间就行了。

先抑后扬，先说缺点：内容较少和建模精度不高，这是受游戏体量影响的，不是大问题。另外还有动作和攻击判定，值得进一步优化。有人提到特效糊脸的问题，我感觉其实还好。把伤害关掉，低特效打开，大部分情况下都是小怪的建模在挡摄像头，特效总的来说是可控的。 再说优点：游戏底子很好，是无需瞄准的轻肉鸽刷子游戏，有玩法支撑。还有两个让我惊喜的地方，一个是载具手感很好，还是这游戏中关键玩法的一部分。一个是主角在镜头中很小，显然作者清楚我们想用镜头看什么（）。刚玩可能会觉得天旋地转，但是这游戏也不需要瞄准，很快就能适应。 期待创意工坊，若开放模型更换会很有潜力。

[h1]巨大娘最带派[/h1] 《带派幸存者3D》是一款非常独特的类幸存者游戏，本作主打的就是各种爽与游戏的3D深度融合，虽说类幸存者这种玩法可以说是非常多了，但能做到带3D和多载具以及各类巨大娘化怪物的，可真是独一份了。游戏中玩家操控一个二头身的二次元美少女，来了有怪物入侵的城市，这个阶段的玩法和同类型的类幸存者差不多，杀怪升级，升级后三选一，自动攻击，鼠标右键可以进行短暂的冲刺，还有个大招，载具交互键是F，是的，这个游戏有多个载具，上到阿帕奇直升机，下到小汽车，都可以用，载具的血量还是独立的，怪多的时候找个载具用用也不错。 [h1]特色[/h1] 游戏画面十分有特色，无论是物品还是怪物，都有这很浓的卡通风格，进入战斗的光污染看着非常的爽，整体节奏比较快，本作最大的特色就是爽，因为从游戏开始，就一直有个引导指引玩家前去地图的一个区域，该区域会有一个巨大的圆圈，靠近后就会刷出本作最大的特色，一个巨大化的娘化怪物，当作boss看待也没什么问题，除了攻高血厚，还会释放各种弹幕类的攻击。想要击败巨大娘，还是挺难的，巨大娘刷出来后小怪更多攻击欲望也更高了，压力陡增，这个时候各种载具就派上用场了，如果实在没法逃，也可以用鼓风机把自己吹到天上，长按空格缓慢降落，利用高度拉开与怪物的距离。 [h1]总结[/h1] 总的来说，这是一款极度爽快的类幸存者游戏，技能、大招、冲刺，载具，能安排的都安排上了，玩着挺带感的，虽说整体的玩法还是没有离开类幸存者游戏那一套的玩法，但也是实打实的做了不少的加法。游戏的成长主要就是三选一技能进行提升，这些技能也有不同的颜色品质区分，颜色越深的加成和效果也就越好。整个游戏透漏着一种爽快刺激的感觉，当然音乐也很带感，在加上各种类型的攻击方式，对巨大娘进行攻击也挺好玩。喜欢这种极度爽快的游戏，那就切莫放过本作，真的很爽。 [quote]欢迎关注我们的鉴赏家:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402982/]走心评测[/url] ←遵从内心，写出真实感受 欢迎加入我们Steam组:[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ZXPC]走心评测[/url]←点击加入，一起探索游戏的乐趣 喜欢这篇评论，也麻烦点个赞，让更多人能够看到！[/quote]

But Really I gotta point out that I'm pretty sure the assets are either lifted/borrowed/stolen from Vtubers, Plants vs Zombies, and other games and rehashed/edited to pass as their own. it's kinda scummy I think. The Chibi Anime Look is cute. however. I'm dead serious when I say one or more characters was taken from a vtuber unless they gave permission. no I'm not much of a vtuber fan. but I even know and have seen enough from time to time to tell some of the models, as I do follow a lot of art and animation content. Nevertheless. the premise is nice. I can't recommend it unless you want to enjoy some samey survivors gameplay.. tho. I give it props for driveable helicopters, vehicles, police cars, and other things. but the movement is stiff and slow.. it just doesn't feel too good to me, and I have played other roguelike and survivor types. there's something working well here. but the presentation isn't here for fun. it's kinda good bad I guess. but still like I said. the art.. maybe not great so not going to recommend if the art is indeed stolen or taken from a database. the chibi vtuber does have some silly videos from what I remember. but it's been too long to say. (who knows they might of sold the model to free use purposes. idk. just reviewing and ranting.)

[h2] 前言：帮巨大娘修理黑丝美脚[/h2] 奇葩辈出的大互联网时代，再小众的审美XP也能找到属于自己的发泄窗口，更别说巨大娘XP可能也不算极其小众~说到底有些“体格差”XP极限化的感觉。从《生化危机8》的八尺夫人，到AI创作下的各种妩媚女奥特曼，乃至一些操控“巨大娘”践踏城市的同人创作，你是否能在这种与女巨人之间巨大的体格差异中感知到一丢丢“兴奋”或者“萌点”呢~ [h2] 玩法：二次元风格、巨大娘XP的3D类幸存者游戏 [/h2] 而《带派幸存者3D》便算是一款二次元风格、巨大娘XP、由两人团队耗时六个月完成的类幸存者游戏。整体依旧算是比较标准的幸存者-like模板。玩家操控Q版二头身小萝莉，自动攻击，在城市地图中击杀不断涌来的僵尸、怪物，生存+杀怪吸收经验、升级三选一获得技能强化，最终召唤并击败作为关底Boss的巨大娘。 大致升级上和其他类幸存者游戏有些许差异，但区别不大；也能够花费金币进行局外养成、初始武器与初始技能的解锁替换、巨大娘的五种皮肤的购买。并且，整体的流程模式上，其实有些《雨中冒险》的感觉——随时间难度逐渐提升，当觉得自己发育足够、或者没法再拖下去了，就可以在地图上寻找并激活祭坛、召唤boss。 [h2] 体验：据说未来还计划加入扮演巨大娘的模式[/h2] 亮点方面，整体3D建模下地图是比较立体化的形式，可以从天桥上跳到桥下面，可以被吹风机吹的老高，建筑内部能进，或者直接无视重力、攀爬高楼，在空中撑起小伞、表演一个萝莉滞空，也有一些飞行怪，这都是平面地图无法带来的；包括地图上分布的各种可驾驶的载具，既能移动也能横冲直撞输出，甚至还能蹦蹦跳跳，都算是一些新鲜点。 虽然整体3D化自然也带来了一些晕3D的问题，反正我是无论是第一视角还是第三视角都晕！但介于制作组很懂行的给巨人娘露出硕大的北半球/南半球，不同的巨人娘也有差异的攻击方式，有的采用街舞动作、搞个大旋风，有的鸭子坐然后双手拍向地面，当然，也少不了经典的玉足践踏，帮巨人娘的修黑丝脚的过程还是很享的~ 可能AI有些笨、进个篮球场就成为“异种”的小型巨人娘永远无法跨越的高墙；可能模型判定与穿模问题有些严重，僵尸虽然也能被墙壁挡住，但也经常是各种挤模型、穿模型，有时候没碰到boss的模型也载具嘎嘎掉血；可能升级与地图所具备的内容体量都较小、想要通关的唯一要点就是勤上载具；但整体还是蛮有猎奇、图个新鲜的胡闹趣味。够带派，可以一试~ [h2]总结[/h2] 定价不高的独立小品作，未来制作组据说还计划加入扮演巨大娘的模式以及创意工坊支持，实现模型替换和自定义内容？感兴趣不妨入手一试~ [quote]加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GHYX]干货游戏[/url]&关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35106417/]咱的鉴赏家[/url]，不定期为大家带来游戏体验分享，也期待您来一起分享自己的游戏体验干货~[/quote]

It's a simple and nice game similar to Megabonk, I had never played that one before, just watched some playthoughs and found it fun, but never bothered with that game, this is the one that got me in. I have two cons for the game. The fact there is only one city, but considering the dev seems to still be working on it, I will assume things may evolve, for example, the Giantess Mode was added more recently. However, the existing city is really big, so not that big of a problem. The other con is that I feel there is a ceiling, it may have been that I just got too strong, but even after a long time, either I was doing extreme damage that even I couldn't realize how much, or the enemies just didn't get strong enough. The reason being, when I'm fully upgraded to a point that I can hardly get anything else, or the upgrades take a long time, even the mini-bosses that spawn midway through die almost as soon as they appear, and I think the reason they don't die earlier is because they are executing some animation, because soon after that ends, they fall and die. I was expecting a bit more of a sponge effect, but some may like that it's not like that. Besides the usual "kill all enemies with random weapons that shoot automatically" and level up to upgrade them, one thing you can do is to get in cars, the advantage is that you you don't take damage, and you can ram into enemies. But most cars don't last that long (Until you get the tank). Oh, and there are no cons being inside a car, as can be seen on the screenshots, you can still climb buildings, only thing you can't do is hover down, so you can do a Yoshi and leave the car anywhere when you don't need it, even at the top of a building. So you can easily play low HP mode much more easily (some of the purchasable upgrades want something like 90% of your HP, then you have to heal yourself again, which can take a long time. But if you have a very small amount, that becomes much more exploitable, which is the big fun of the game). After some time, random smaller giantesses are summoned, they run towards you (if you don't kill them before), and attack you with relatively slow attacks. If you don't kill them in time (for example, you went really far thus they are not being killed), multiple ones could spawn. Like Megabonk, your objective is to summon the big giant girl, and once you kill her, you win the game, and can play the game with your unlockables or higher difficulty. The game does feature a Photo Mode, although it's not related to a menu but a button, so it's easy to trigger, but can be a bit annoying when you trigger it by mistake on a gamepad. --- GTS mode is also something that has to be worked a bit more, you are the giantess this time, and you are literally invincible. You have to kill people and vehicles to power up, the problem is, your attacks are somewhat slow and hard imprecise (it's the same attacks from the boss version), you can upgrade it, but it can take a really long time because she is so slow
